What it means: Which column of the grid the tile is in, counting from 0 at the left. A whole number.
Which row of the grid the tile is in, counting from 0 at the top. Elsewhere in Quorum, y counts up from the bottom; tileset files are the exception. A whole number.
How many squares wide the tile is. Leave it out for 1.
How many squares tall the tile is. Leave it out for 1. A door two squares tall would have 2.
The name shown in the palette and read by screen readers. A placed tile takes this name, and code finds it by this name.

What the tile looks like, in words. It isn't shown in the palette; each placed tile gets it as its description, for screen readers. If it is missing, the description becomes an error message, so always include it.
A group inside this tileset, such as Boy. Tiles without one are listed directly under the tileset's name.
true, with no quotation marks, if placed tiles should have physics turned on. Leave it out for no physics.
Only with Physics Enabled. 0 is Unmovable (walls and floors), 1 is Nonresponsive (moved only by code) and 2 is Responsive (pushed by forces and gravity).
